questions: How might the application of a phase-coherent de-rotation algorithm to measure the rotation measure of FRB 20200917A inform our understanding of the bimodal distribution of radio bursts and their differing radiation mechanisms?

In what ways could the large-scale clustering information of dispersion measures contribute to our understanding of the statistical similarities between pulse arrival times in FRB 121102 and magnetar high-energy short bursts?
What is the nature of the mechanisms underlying fast radio bursts?

To what extent could the exploration of coherent curvature radiation and synchrotron maser as radiation mechanisms for fast radio bursts lead to a reevaluation of the fundamental principles governing their emission?
Could the transient phenomena observed following FRB 150418 be reinterpreted as evidence against the prevailing theories of fast radio burst origins?
